data.name: Birger's Saga
data.detailed_description:
A Midlife Crisis Never Looked So Violent

Meet Birger the Bastard. Decades ago, he was the undisputed, blood-soaked terror of Jordenheim. Today? He’s an over-the-hill, middle-aged grump whose knees pop louder than thunder and who desperately misses the glory days of yore. Instead of buying a flashy new longship to cope with his Viking midlife crisis, Birger has decided to sprint headfirst into endless danger to prove he’s still top dog. What could possibly go wrong?

Welcome to Birger's Saga, a lightning-fast, retro-style endless runner packed with rogue-lite progression, relentless action, and an alarming lack of cardio conditioning.

Die, Upgrade, Complain, Repeat

Don't let the gray beard fool you. The action here is mercilessly fast. You’ll be dodging, slashing, and sprinting through the Norse-inspired world of Jordenheim. Because this is a rogue-lite, Birger is going to bite the dust—a lot. Fortunately, Valhalla doesn't want him yet, and death is just an excuse to catch his breath and spend his hard-earned loot.

Between runs, hit the local camp to patch up Birger's aging arsenal. Enhance your weapons, unlock new perks, and chug questionable consumables to give this tired anti-hero the edge he needs to run just a little bit further on the next attempt.

Core Features of Birger's Desperation:

  • High-Speed Midlife Crisis: Fast-paced, endless running action that will test your gaming reflexes (and Birger's stamina).

  • Rogue-Lite Progression: Death isn't a failure; it's a mandatory water break. Carry your loot back to camp to unlock permanent upgrades and character enhancements.

  • Retro Arcade Charm: Old-school, retro-style aesthetics that harken back to the golden age of gaming—which, coincidentally, was the last time Birger was relevant.

  • Pimp My Axe: Spend your plunder on devastating weapon upgrades to slice through Jordenheim’s nastiest foes with terrifying efficiency.

  • Questionable Consumables: Down a variety of temporary buffs and suspect brews to keep Birger’s aching joints moving at breakneck speeds during your runs.

Grab your trusty axe, do some light stretching, and help Birger reclaim his former glory before it's time for his afternoon nap!

Die, upgrade your weapons, chug potions, and prove those aging knees still have one last epic adventure left in them!

  • Graphics: Nvidia 2000 series or higher equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 11
